newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases as month-end payments over.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases as month-end payments over.

text.p: The rouble eased on Tuesday as banks bought dollars with funds left over from month-end payments reservations for Wednesday's auctions af government securities, dealers said.
On March 5 the central bank is auctioning 7.5 trillion roubles of six-month paper and an additional tranche of 4.5 trillion roubles of six-month bills.
roubles/dollar Mar 4 midday Mar 4 early Mar 3 close
"Rouble supply has grown after the month started. Some funds may go to the (T-bill) auctions but the dollar will be rising anyway in March," a Bank SBS-Agro dealer said.
He said only high-scale rouble purchases by the government would stop the decline.
An Interbank Finance House dealer said the rouble had edged up in early speculative trading but the trend was short, given low rouble credit rates.
The rouble was cheap as lower-yielding T-bills were less attractive, and banks were seeking funds ahead of the auctions less aggressively than in the past, dealers said.
